data.title: About Denise
bio: Denise Meyers was born into a family of real estate investors, builders and real estate agents.  It was in her DNA to follow in her family’s footsteps.  She began her real estate career in 1993.  A Broker/Associate with a passion for all things real estate related.

In her long real estate career Denise has specialized in land development transactions, marketing of new construction and residential resales.  She enjoys working with buyers, sellers, builders and investors.  A lifelong resident of Middlesex County who currently resides in Monroe Township with her husband of 30+ years, George Meyers, in a home that they built in 1997.  They have one son, George Jr.

, who is a Monroe Township school teacher, coach and who is now also following in the family's footsteps as a realtor.  If you're looking for a Realtor to help you achieve your real estate goals than you need to look no further than Denise.  She can be reached at 732 586-2888.
